summary: freeportwest/Opal_Darkbriar (quests.id 15231): remove the later-era 'trades' / 'second book' dialogue. Before: saying 'trades' or 'second book' summons 51121 Tradeskill Basics : Volume I or 51122 Volume II, neither of which exists in data/items, and the Tattered Note welcome ends with a [trades] prompt. After: a new maintained modified-upstream override with no event_say (those two branches were its only content, so has_say_event becomes 0), without 51121/51122 in the items header, and with the welcome ending at the Shana Liskia sentence, as maintained overrides such as felwitheb/Kinool_Goldsinger do. The Tattered Note hand-in, its robe, faction and EXP, and the proximity message are unchanged. The ledger-reviewed The Burning Dead decision (no Opal wand branch) is unaffected. Validation: source review, check-proposal, npm test and npm run validate. Not runtime tested.

evidence.note: Offline page reference/p99-wiki/npc-pages/opal-darkbriar-396a4e5e49.wiki (fetched 2026-08-12T20:21:38.954Z) lists zone 'West Freeport OR East Freeport' and related_quests '* [[The Burning Dead]]' and '* [[Guild Summons - Dismal Rage Necromancer]]'. Neither is a tradeskill book quest. The offline title list reference/p99-wiki/allpages-ns0.json (fetched 2026-07-17T22:59:57.533Z, complete: true, 28488 titles) has no 'Tradeskill Basics' title. data/items has neither 51121 nor 51122.

content_exclusions.json review 'The Burning Dead' (reviewed_at 2026-07-19) lists freeportwest/Opal_Darkbriar and says no Opal wand-creation branch was added. This change adds none and removes no hand-in. The maintained freeporteast/Opal_Darkbriar override (review 'Guild Summons - Dismal Rage Necromancer', note: 'East Freeport Opal now removes later tradeskill-book prompts') and the freportw/Opal_Darkbriar script (quests.id 13132, has_say_event 0) have no trades dialogue.

Repo precedent: 48 maintained overrides whose ProjectEQ source summons 51121 drop the trades branch. Maintained felwitheb/Kinool_Goldsinger.lua:37, felwitheb/Niola_Impholder.lua:36, felwithea/Yeolarn_Bronzeleaf.lua and rivervale/Sheriff_Roglio.lua keep the 'see <trainer> ... hunting and gathering skills.' sentence and drop only the 'Return to me ... [trades] ...' sentence. Before this change the only effective scripts that still summon 51121/51122 are freeportwest/Lorme_Tredore (separate proposal), freeportwest/Romiak_Jusathorn, freeportwest/Opal_Darkbriar and freeporteast/Cain_Darkmoore.
